transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net landline customer services. My name is Oliver. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Oliver. I am calling regarding my mother's landline telephone service. She has been inundated with dozens of aggressive automated marketing calls and threatening financial scam callers over the past two weeks, and we desperately need these nuisance calls blocked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you activate call barring and security features on the telephone line, Fatima. Before we access the account features, may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 29 Victoria Road, Oxford, OX2 7NB. And the security question answer is my mother's favourite flower, Jasmine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Fatima, that verifies the telephone account records. What is the landline telephone number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The landline number is 01865 773910. Oliver, my mother is eighty-seven years old and lives with moderate vascular dementia. These scammers have been ringing her at two and three o'clock in the morning claiming to be police officers and demanding her life savings! She was found shivering and weeping in the hallway by her morning carer, terrified that someone was coming to arrest her! It is literally destroying her health!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the telephone exchange feature flags provisioned on this landline number on our switch database.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please, we need whatever protections S-Net can put on this line right away.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the Openreach local exchange subscriber routing profile for the Oxford exchange.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the line profile currently have enabled?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The line currently has standard dial tone and Caller ID active, with zero incoming call screening features enabled.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No wonder all those predatory callers were getting straight through to her bedside table!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We will provision Anonymous Call Rejection and S-Net Call Guardian directly on the telephone exchange switch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does Anonymous Call Rejection work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Anonymous Call Rejection automatically blocks any incoming telephone call where the caller intentionally withholds their telephone number or displays a spoofed private identity.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the scammer hear when they try to ring her?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The caller hears an automated network message stating: 'The person you are calling is not accepting anonymous calls; please disconnect, unwithhold your number, and try again'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is wonderful, because most of these late-night scammers withhold their caller ID completely!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Her phone will never ring once when an anonymous caller dials the number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will stop the midnight wakeups immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Next, we will activate S-Net Call Guardian, which provides interactive screening for international and unrecognized numbers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does Call Guardian screen calls for someone with dementia?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Call Guardian maintains an approved contact VIP list. When you, her doctor, or her carers call from numbers on the VIP list, the call rings through directly without any interruption.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I give you her essential family and medical numbers to add to that VIP list right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, please provide up to five primary telephone numbers for the trusted VIP whitelist.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: First is my mobile, 07700 900821. Second is my brother Tariq, 07700 900512. Third is her GP surgery, 01865 249100. And fourth is the Oxford Care Agency, 01865 882190.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have added those four numbers to the permanent VIP bypass list.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens if someone not on the list rings, like a genuine friend from her church?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The caller is asked by an automated attendant to speak their name clearly; Call Guardian records their voice, calls you on your mobile, and asks if you wish to accept the call.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Automated robocallers cannot speak their name, so they just disconnect automatically!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Computer autodialers cannot navigate the voice recording prompt and drop the connection immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is an absolute godsend for vulnerable elderly people.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The telephony exchange routing engine has provisioned both Call Guardian and Anonymous Call Rejection on the Oxford switch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are those features live on her line right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, both network features take effect immediately across all incoming trunks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let us perform a test right now. I will withhold my number on my mobile by dialling 141 before her home number and see what happens.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead, let us verify the Anonymous Call Rejection intercept.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing 141 01865 773910... listening on my mobile... it didn't ring her landline! A clear automated voice said: 'The person you are calling is not accepting anonymous calls'! The line disconnected!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms the network trunk filter rejected the withheld CLI packet before line ringing occurred, Fatima.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now let me test calling without 141 from my mobile, which is on the VIP whitelist.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead, confirm whitelist VIP bypass.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing her home number normally... her landline phone across the room is ringing immediately with clear chime! It works flawlessly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The whitelist feature bypassed the screening engine in three hundred milliseconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are there any monthly subscription fees for Anonymous Call Rejection and Call Guardian?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Both security features are provided free of charge under S-Net's Nuisance Call Protection policy for vulnerable customers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is so good to know, especially for pensioners on fixed incomes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the Telephone Preference Service registration status to help reduce unsolicited direct marketing calls permanently.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is her number currently registered with the TPS?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am querying the national TPS database; her landline was registered three years ago.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, so legitimate marketing companies are legally barred from dialling her anyway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Companies calling numbers registered on the TPS face substantial regulatory fines from the Information Commissioner's Office.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives us an extra layer of legal protection.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also add her social worker, Deborah Davies, to the Call Guardian VIP bypass list so care assessments can ring through directly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, Deborah's direct office number is 01865 921440. Please add her to the VIP list.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Deborah Davies has been added to the approved contact list on the exchange profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That ensures social services can always reach her immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to check, Fatima, is your mother's broadband connection and medical alert pendant operating without any technical issues?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, her medical pendant connects via the telephone socket and has dial tone, and her WiFi is working fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this support case and record the Call Guardian settings on her account file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Oliver, you have given my mother her peace of mind and peaceful sleep back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can log into the S-Net online portal at any time to add new numbers to the trusted contact list.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will bookmark the portal link on my tablet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your mother's S-Net landline or call features that I can assist you with today, Fatima?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has solved our nightmare completely. Thank you Oliver.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a short customer satisfaction survey by SMS after this call; we would appreciate any feedback you can provide.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will fill out the survey with top scores. Good afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Fatima. Please pass our best wishes to your mother, and take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
